query: INSERT INTO ai_settings (id, base_url, api_key, model) VALUES (1, ?, ?, ?) ON CONFLICT(id) DO UPDATE SET base_url = CASE WHEN ? THEN excluded.base_url ELSE ai_settings.base_url END, api_key = CASE WHEN ? THEN excluded.api_key ELSE ai_settings.api_key END, model = CASE WHEN ? THEN excluded.model ELSE ai_settings.model END
